reader_summary.headline: This is Jesse Pujji and today’s episode is a follow up of last weeks’ Block episode.
reader_summary.overview: This is Jesse Pujji and today’s episode is a follow up of last weeks’ Block episode, covering Afterpay the buy-now-pay-later giant. Founded in Sydney Australia in 2015, Afterpay was a rapid success in the buy-now-pay-later market before being acquired by Block for $29bn in 2021. To breakdown Afterpay, I am joined by investor Joe Magyer.

key_points.text: We cover how buy-now-pay-later compares to traditional credit cards, what differentiates Afterpay from direct peers.
Please enjoy this business breakdown of Afterpay.
